item.description: The Supreme Court ruled weeks ago that Donald Trump cannot erase birthright citizenship with an executive order. Today he tried again. He signed two new orders restricting who is born a citizen, called the 6 to 3 ruling from his own conservative majority "very unfortunate," and told reporters "we're making adjustments." The Constitution says every baby born in America is a citizen. He is making adjustments everywhere the answer is no. His FCC just voted to erase a broadcast ownership cap Congress wrote into law, a power Senate Commerce Chairman Ted Cruz doubts it has. And the union of career IRS auditors joined a suit to block the audit shield his administration built around his family's taxes. The objections come from his own side now and have changed nothing. item.title: Soon-to-be new Foster Kitten!
item.description:
My hairdresser knows I foster kittens, and when her son found a stray baby, she asked if I’d be willing to take it in!
I asked Jess if I could foster the little girl (we’re guessing she’s a girl) until she’s old enough to be put up for adoption by the humane society and she said yes!
So Imgur…meet Bump!
She is named Bump because his toddler son is obsessed with asking everyone to fist bump, including her! (No word on if she’s returned the bump)
They’re keeping her in their garage (I asked and, no, it’s not too hot) because one of their kids is allergic to cats. But she gets to roam around and be fierce when they can watch her.
Jess told me Spencer, the CEO of the humane society, is going to pull some kittens from local shelters soon, so I’m going to wait to pick her up until I have some friends for her to spend time with in the kitten room. I can’t wait to meet her!
